leak_sizes.note: Models and thresholds must be chosen solely using train_areas_m2. Held-out areas are evaluated strictly once at the end.

no_leak_days.note: Untouched final evaluation days are evaluated strictly once at the end.

visibility_criterion.definition: Steady-state pressure drop exceeding 3 * NOISE_SD (0.9 m) at any of the 8 sensors
